narration: You've got fifty thousand dollars in a savings account. Feels responsible, right? But here's what that 'safety' is secretly costing you.
visual: Animated piggy bank SVG springs into frame center. Dollar counter counts up from $0 to $50,000. Label 'YOUR SAVINGS ACCOUNT' above. 'feels responsible, right?' fades in below counter. Dark background.

narration: Experts agree — keep three to six months of expenses liquid. That's your emergency fund. Everything above that number is dead weight draining your future.
visual: Two panels slide in from opposite sides. Left green panel: stacked coins labeled '3-6 MONTHS / EMERGENCY FUND' with checkmark. Right red panel: money bag draining with X mark labeled 'ABOVE THAT / DEAD WEIGHT'. Light background.

narration: Fifty grand in savings at four percent — thirty years, a hundred sixty-two thousand dollars. Same money in an index fund? Eight hundred seventy-two thousand. Wild, right?
visual: Two vertical bar charts grow upward from baseline. Left dim bar labeled 'SAVINGS 4%' reaches $162K. Right bright green bar labeled 'INDEX FUND 10%' towers to $872K — 5x taller. Dark background.

narration: That's a seven hundred ten thousand dollar difference. Not from gambling on risky stocks. Just from moving money you were never going to touch anyway.
visual: Giant '$710,000' springs into center of screen in bold green text. Below it: 'Same $50,000 start. 30 years. No extra risk.' Arrow visual showing gap from low to high. Light background.

narration: Sixty-six percent of Americans hold too much cash. Your brain fears a market crash more than it wants wealth. Meanwhile inflation's slowly eating your savings alive.
visual: Person silhouette clutching money bag tightly with downward market chart arrow in background. Large '66%' stat springs in red. Below: 'Fear of crashes beats the math — every time.' Dark background.

narration: Calculate your three-month expense number, keep only that liquid. Invest everything above it. Your future self is literally begging you to make this move today.
visual: Three checklist steps slide in one by one: '1 - Calculate 3 months expenses', '2 - Keep only that liquid', '3 - Invest the rest'. Person silhouette with upward arrow above steps. 'FOLLOW FOR MORE' CTA at bottom. Light background.
